Professional and service disclosures.

Accounting services

ClarityGrid Accounting & Advisory is not represented as a CPA firm. Services do not include audit, review, compilation, attestation, legal advice, investment advice or tax opinions unless expressly provided through a qualified third party under a separate agreement.

Commercial lease abstraction

Lease abstracts are administrative summaries of documents supplied by the client. They are not legal interpretations, title opinions or substitutes for review by qualified counsel. Clients remain responsible for confirming critical rights, duties and dates.

Commercial energy

Supplier availability, quote eligibility and brokerage services vary by state, utility territory, account type and market conditions. A quote request is not an offer, guarantee of savings or authorization to enroll. Applicable supplier, broker and authorization disclosures are provided during the procurement process.

Transportation reporting

Responsibilities for filings, registrations and source-data accuracy are defined in the engagement agreement. ClarityGrid does not provide legal representation before a regulator.

Credentials and trademarks

Credentials identify training or certification issued by the named organization; they do not imply endorsement beyond the applicable program terms. Intuit, QuickBooks and QuickBooks ProAdvisor are trademarks of Intuit Inc. ADP is a trademark of ADP, Inc.
